answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier inspects every output like a sparrow scanning the ground for seeds, ensuring no shared logic exists. Much like a nebula that forms from singular gas pockets, every identity must anchor its proof to a specific ledger slot. If a duplicate emerges across the dune of existing work, the system triggers permanent identity exclusion. No costs are ever refunded, locking the identity to its scarce proof.
